theorems.name: Submission.cmb_exists_compactly_contained_exhaustion
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∃ W : ℕ → Set (Eucl P), (∀ i, CompactlyContainedOpen (W i) U) ∧ ∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ i, K ⊆ W i
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
